purpose: Pre-data finite-sample cadence sanity check only; not market evidence, a normality-test p-value, a performance estimate, or a substitute for Q02.
limitations: Overlapping rolling monthly windows in a backtest are dependent; this independent-null calculation does not estimate actual trade count.
Raw WTI returns need not be Gaussian, independent, stationary, or distributed like this synthetic input.
The 1.04 boundary is an empirical finite-sample median used only as a predeclared state divider, not a normality rejection threshold or p-value.
SciPy explicitly cautions that the asymptotic chi-square calibration needs a much larger sample; no asymptotic critical value or p-value is used here.
Q02 owns actual completed-position frequency, costs, economics, and all market-data conclusions.
